introduce:
Start on all fours with your hips lifted, forming an inverted V-shape. Keep your arms shoulder-width apart and your feet flat on the floor, aligned with your hips.

Exhale, lift your heels and bend your knees, bringing your chest towards your knees while keeping your arms straight. Inhale, straighten your legs and transition back to the inverted V-shape.

Lift your heels again, then bring your upper body towards your legs and arch your back.

Transition back to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: REVERSE BRIDGE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Coordinate your breath with your flow.
Make sure there is enough distance between your hands and feet.
Press your hands firmly into the floor.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform the flow slowly and with control.
Maintain the natural extension of your spine.
Don't strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your back, chest, and legs.
This exercise strengthens your core and enhances spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Sit with your knees slightly bent, feet naturally on the floor, chest up, and your hands resting on your knees.

Inhale, twist your torso to the left, reaching your left hand back as far as possible while your right hand holds the outside of your left knee. Exhale as you transition back, then repeat on the other side.

Reach your left hand back again, and as your torso returns to the center, sweep your left arm overhead and dive it down to the outside of your opposite knee. Complete this flow on the other side.

Return to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: SPIRALING TWIST FLOW

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to maintain balance.
Inhale as your arm reaches back and exhale as it returns.
Perform the flow slowly and with control.
Reach your arm as far back as possible.
Perform smoothly and feel the flow in your body.
This exercise enhances your spinal flexibility.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and the sides of your body.

introduce:
Sit with your torso facing right, your right leg bent in front and your left leg bent behind. Place your hands on the floor for support, keeping your back straight and chest up.

Inhale, arch your back as your head naturally tilts back to fully open your chest. Exhale, slowly return to the starting position.

Turn your torso to the left with your left knee in front, and repeat this movement.
name: ARCH AND CURL WITH MERMAID STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale as you arch your back, exhale as you return.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Perform this movement slowly and with control.
This exercise stretches your chest and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and together, arms reaching forward at shoulder width. Lift your upper body and legs slightly, and keep them off the floor throughout the exercise.

Exhale, engage your core, and lift your legs and torso, bringing your hands and feet closer. Inhale, slowly lower your legs and torso.

Repeat this movement.
name: JACKKNIFE WITH FEET OFF

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale as you lift, and inhale as you lower.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
Keep your legs and arms straight at all times.
Keep your head and neck relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your core.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs extended and together, arms reaching forward at shoulder width. Lift your upper body and legs slightly, and keep them off the floor throughout the exercise.\n\nEngage your core and perform a scissor motion by crossing one leg over the other, alternating sides in a controlled and steady rhythm.
name: JACKKNIFE SCISSORS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, stacking your hands on your right hip.

Exhale, slide your hands down along your right leg to your foot. Continue moving your hands across the floor to your left foot. Inhale, slide them up along your leg to your hip, then slowly lean back and arch your spine.

Repeat on the other side with a steady rhythm.
name: STANDING ARCH AND CURL WITH ROTATION

tips.text: Exhale as your hands slide downward, inhale as they slide upward.
Engage your core to maintain balance.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.
Lean back moderately and with control.
This exercise enhances your spinal flexibility.
This exercise stretches your back and legs.

introduce:
Sit with your right leg bent back and your left leg bent in front of you. Place your left hand on the floor behind you for support and rest your right hand on your right knee, keeping your chest up.

Inhale, engage your core and press through your thigh to lift your torso. Simultaneously, sweep your right arm across your body and overhead, arching your back naturally.

Exhale, return to the starting position and repeat with a steady rhythm.
name: LEFT MERMAID ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce:
Sit with your left leg bent back and your right leg bent in front of you. Place your right hand on the floor behind you for support and rest your left hand on your left knee, keeping your chest up.

Inhale, engage your core and press through your thigh to lift your torso. Simultaneously, sweep your left arm across your body and overhead, arching your back naturally.

Exhale, return to the starting position and repeat with a steady rhythm.
name: RIGHT MERMAID ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce:
Sit with your legs together and extended forward, leaning back with your forearms supported on the floor and lifting your legs slightly, keeping your insteps straight.

Inhale, engage your core and bring your knees toward your chest, then extend your legs upward with your toes pointing downward. Exhale, circle your legs to the left and back to the starting position.

Repeat on the other side with a steady rhythm.
name: DOUBLE LEG CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

Inhale as you bring your legs toward your chest, and exhale as you lower them.

This exercise effectively strengthens your core.

introduce:
Sit with your knees open to the sides and the soles of your feet together. Hold your feet with your hands and lean forward to stretch your inner thighs.

Next, extend your right leg to the side with your hands on your knees and tilt your torso to the right to deepen the stretch. Bring your leg back, and switch sides to stretch your left leg.

Then, bring your left leg back and lean forward again. Extend your legs to the sides and bend your torso forward with your hands on the floor.

Return to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: LEG STRETCH FLOW

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Maintain steady breathing.
This exercise stretches your adductors and hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit with your knees open to the sides and the soles of your feet together. Place your hands on the floor behind you for support, with your fingers pointing outward.

Engage your core and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips off the floor, forming a tabletop position with your head relaxed.

Then, lower your torso to the starting position. Extend your legs straight forward and reach your hands toward your feet.

Return to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: FROG STRETCH FLOW

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale as you lower them.
Perform this flow slowly and with control.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and core.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and lower back.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on your waist, and chest up.

Raise your right knee toward your chest, then lower your right foot and take a large step to the right.

Switch legs and repeat this movement.
name: SIDE STEP KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
Perform the movement in a controlled manner.
This exercise stretches your hips.
This exercise improves your balance and coordination.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward, placing your hands on your knees. Curl your back smoothly and tuck your chin to your chest.

Inhale, arch your back and lift your head to look toward the ceiling. Simultaneously, slide your hands from your knees to your hips and open your knees and feet outward.

Exhale, slowly transition back to the starting position and repeat.
name: CHAIR ARCH AND CURL

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Perform this flow slowly and with control.
Inhale as you arch your back, and exhale as you curl it.
Make sure there is enough distance between your feet.
Keep your weight centered on your sit bones.
This exercise stretches your spine, chest, and hips.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes and knees turned inward. Curl your back smoothly and extend your arms straight with the backs of your hands resting inside your knees.

Inhale, arch your back, reaching your right hand toward the ceiling and extending it backward to open your chest. Simultaneously, turn your knees and feet outward.

Exhale, slowly transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR ARCH AND CURL WITH CHEST OPENER

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

Make sure there is enough distance between your feet.
Keep your weight centered on your sit bones.
Extend your arm back as far as possible with control.

This exercise improves the flexibility of your shoulders and spine.
This exercise improves your posture and relieves tension.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet much wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing outward. Place your hands on your thighs, keep your back straight, and gaze forward.

Swing your torso to the left in a wave-like motion while sliding your left hand along your thigh toward your knee.

Swing to the other side and repeat on both sides alternately.
name: CHAIR SIDE TO SIDE ARCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Maintain steady breathing.
Let your head move naturally with your torso.
Avoid leaning forward or backward.
Perform the flow slowly and fluidly.
This exercise improves your spinal flexibility.
This exercise stretches the sides of your torso and relieves tension.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet much wider than shoulder-width apart. Place your hands on your thighs, elbows pointing forward. Keep your back straight and gaze ahead.

Exhale, arch your back, and bend your torso forward while rotating your heels outward and opening your legs to the sides. Inhale, curl your back and transition back to the starting position.

Repeat this flow several times.
name: CHAIR WAVES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Exhale as you bend forward, and inhale as you return.
Perform this flow slowly and fluidly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
This exercise improves the flexibility of your spine.
This exercise stretches your hips.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet hip-width apart and your toes touching the floor, placing the backs of your hands on your lower back while keeping your back straight.

Inhale, bend your torso forward while raising both hands along your torso to your head, then lower them in a circular motion. Simultaneously, step your left foot forward with only your toes touching the floor.

Exhale, transition back to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR FULL CIRCLES WITH HAMSTRING STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform this flow slowly and fluidly.
Inhale as you bend your torso, and exhale as you return.
Keep your toes grounded throughout the exercise.

This exercise helps stretch your hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward. Place your hands on your thighs, keep your back straight, and gaze forward.

Exhale, twist your torso to the right while sliding your right hand toward your waist and your left hand toward your knee. Follow your right shoulder with your gaze.

Inhale, transition back to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: CHAIR SPIRALING TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to the center.
Perform the flow slowly and with control.
This exercise improves your spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Sit with your feet together and your hands gripping the sides of the chair. Lean your torso back to lift your feet off the floor with your knees bent and toes pointing down.

Extend your legs forward with your insteps straight, open your legs to the sides and draw circles inward to return to the starting position.

Repeat this movement.
name: CHAIR OUTWARD LEG CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core.
Maintain steady breathing.
Always keep your chest up and your back straight.
Perform the circular movement as fully as possible.
Always keep your feet off the floor.

introduce:
Sit with your feet together and your hands gripping the sides of the chair. Lean your torso back to lift your feet off the floor with your knees bent and toes pointing down.

Open your legs to the sides and extend them with your insteps straight, then draw circles inward to return to the center and bend your knees to the starting position.

Repeat this movement.
name: CHAIR INWARD LEG CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your legs together, keeping your chest up and back straight. Grip the sides of the chair with your hands, lean your torso back, and keep your feet off the floor.

Exhale, engage your core, and lift your knees while kicking your right leg upward with your toes tucked inward.

Inhale, lower your knees, and switch legs to repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

Grip the sides of the chair with your hands, lean your torso back, and lift your legs to keep them parallel to the floor.\n\nBend your knees, keep your thighs still and draw circles with your feet counterclockwise.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet much wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing to the sides. Keep your chest up and your back straight.

Cross your hands with your palms facing down. Then, pull your hands to the right until your right upper arm is in line with your right shoulder.

Sweep your hands in a clockwise circle along your upper body.

Switch directions to repeat this movement.
name: CHAIR ARM STIRRING

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet much wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing to the sides. Cross your hands in front of your chest with your palms facing forward.

Keep your arms parallel to the floor and draw a large clockwise circle in front of you, curling your back as your hands move away, and arching your torso as they come back.

Switch directions and repeat the movement.
name: CHAIR SPINAL STIRRING

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Maintain steady breathing.

introduce:
Sit on the chair with your feet hip-width apart and your hands resting on your thighs. Keep your chest up and your back straight.

Exhale, kick your right foot up, then inhale, and bend your knee to place your right foot above your left knee. Exhale, lean your torso forward, gently press your right knee down with your right hand, and pull up your right foot with your left hand to deepen the stretch.

Inhale, return your torso to upright, kick your right foot up again, and then place it back on the floor. Exhale, bend your torso forward, bringing your chest as close to your knee as possible.

Return to the starting position and switch sides to repeat this sequence.
name: CHAIR FIGURE 4 STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce:

Exhale, lift your right knee and curl your back. Inhale, extend your right leg forward while arching your back.

Transition back to the starting position, then switch legs to repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
